commands.assets: [search TEXT]; bounded local curated icon names
commands.check/rebuild: --store DIR; rebuild preserves divergent SVG under recovered/
commands.get: --store DIR --id ID; complete targeted element and snapshot
commands.merge: --base FILE --ours FILE --theirs FILE; pure three-way source merge
commands.move: --store DIR --expected HASH --request ID --id ID --dx N --dy N (edges unchanged)
commands.remove: --store DIR --expected HASH --request ID --id ID [--cascade]; linked Items refused
commands.render: --store DIR > drawing.svg; checks hash and selectors
commands.source: --store DIR; complete source including asset pins

rules: pinned font; overflow errors, no auto-resizing
SVG fragment subset, no arbitrary import
